parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Good morning, Riverdale Preschool, Sally speaking.

Hello. My name's Robert. I've got a four-year-old daughter called Susie, and I'd like to get some information about your preschool, please.

Sure, Robert. Well, Susie's the right age. We take three- and four-year-olds in classes of twenty students.

Oh, great. And how many teachers do you have?

We have two. The first group is taught by Mrs. Oliver, and the second is taken by Mrs. Keogh.

Just a moment. I'll write that down. Could you spell the last name, please? It's an unusual one, isn't it?

Yes. It's K-E-O-G-H.

Okay. I've got that. But I know the children attend for two or three days.

That's right. The older ones, like Susie, attend for three days, which means 15 hours a week. The younger ones, the three-year-olds, attend two days a week. That's a total of 10 hours.

And what do they do during that time?

Well, half the day is spent outside, and the children can run around and play games with their friends, or do a calmer activity, like painting, for example. We have a great outside play area that we're improving all the time.

Yes. We were walking past the other day and Susie noticed you've recently added a new slide, haven't you?

Yes. We're really pleased with it. It's a big one, and the children love it. And are you thinking of adding anything else outdoors?

Well, we were hoping to build a playhouse, but that was too expensive. We're now making plans for a garden, where the children will be able to grow flowers and vegetables.

Lovely. And what else do the children do?

Well, the other half of the day is spent indoors. This year, the children seem to be very interested in music, so the teachers are doing a lot of activities related to that. Last year, there seemed to be more of an interest in dancing.

Well, Susie would love either of those.

The teachers may sometimes play quiet games with the children, but we read them a story each day. It's a very important part of the programme here.

Yes, of course.

Now, I'd like to ask you about the fees, if that's okay.

Sure. We actually had to put them up this term, I'm afraid.

Yes. I heard from a friend of mine that it used to be $420 for the term, but it's just gone up to $470, is that right?

Yes. We had to add the extra $50 to cover costs. Things got a lot more expensive last year.

I understand. And I think the fees are still quite reasonable. Another school I've spoken to charges $500 per term.

Oh, really?

My friend also told me that his daughter went on a trip to the local zoo and that the cost of that was covered in the fees, is that right?

Yes. We did that last year, but we'll be going to a farm this year instead. We vary it, so for example, we may go to the theatre next year.

Okay. It sounds like fun. Also included in the price is membership of a special library. Children can borrow a toy and keep it for a week and choose a different one the following week. It's very popular.

What a great idea. We would certainly make use of that system if we enrol. Now, is there anything else I should know?

Well, the children have a rest here during the day and we make up a little bed for them with sheets and blankets, but we advise parents to pack a pillow in the child's bag as we don't provide one.

Okay. I'll make a note of that. So what should I do if I want to come and look around the school during the day and meet the staff?

The best thing is to call the teacher on the classroom mobile and she'll tell you which time is best to visit. Shall I give you the number?

Yes, please. Okay. It's 0914638520.

Thanks for all your help, Sally. And we hope to see you soon.

No problem. Bye for now.

analyses.content: 听到这里是填人名，录音中不仅说了名字，还专门紧接着进行了逐个字母的拼写 K-E-O-G-H。
Just a moment. I'll write that down. Could you spell the last name, please? It's an unusual one, isn't it? Yes. It's K-E-O-G-H.
听到 "unusual"（不常见）这个词就要做好准备记录拼写，注意不要把 G 听成 J。
That's right. The older ones, like Susie, attend for three days, which means 15 hours a week. The younger ones, the three-year-olds, attend two days a week. That's a total of 10 hours.
你可能会听到 "10 hours"，但那是针对三岁小班（younger ones）的时间，不要张冠李戴。
录音中提到像 Susie 这样的大孩子（older ones）每周上三天，意味着每周 15 小时。
Well, we were hoping to build a playhouse, but that was too expensive. We're now making plans for a garden, where the children will be able to grow flowers and vegetables.
Playhouse 是本来想做但太贵了（放弃了），Slide 是最近已经加好的（过去式），都要排除。
题目问的是 "intend to make"（打算做），对应录音中的 "making plans for a garden"。

Well, the other half of the day is spent indoors. This year, the children seem to be very interested in music, so the teachers are doing a lot of activities related to that. Last year, there seemed to be more of an interest in dancing.
听到 "dancing" 不要急着填，录音说那是 "last year"（去年）更感兴趣的活动。
题目问 "this year"（今年），录音明确说今年孩子们似乎对 music 非常感兴趣。
The teachers may sometimes play quiet games with the children, but we read them a story each day. It's a very important part of the programme here.
不要填 "games"，录音说游戏只是 "sometimes"（有时）玩，并不是每天。
题目问每天 "hear"（听）什么，录音中说 "read them a story each day"，读故事就是听故事。
题目问现在的费用，录音说费用刚刚 "gone up to"（涨到了）470 美元。
Yes. I heard from a friend of mine that it used to be $420 for the term, but it's just gone up to $470, is that right? Yes. We had to add the extra $50 to cover costs.
420 是涨价前的老价格，500 是另一所学校的收费，50 是涨价的差额，都不能填。

My friend also told me that his daughter went on a trip to the local zoo... Yes. We did that last year, but we'll be going to a farm this year instead. We vary it, so for example, we may go to the theatre next year.
Zoo 是去年去的，Theatre 是明年可能去的，注意时间状语的匹配。
题目限定 "this year"（今年）去哪，录音明确回答今年会去一个 farm（农场）。
Also included in the price is membership of a special library. Children can borrow a toy and keep it for a week and choose a different one the following week.
虽然提到了 "library"（图书馆），但不要想当然地填 "book"，这里是一个特殊的玩具图书馆。
题目问每周能带回家一个什么，录音说孩子可以借一个 toy 并保留一周。
Well, the children have a rest here during the day and we make up a little bed for them with sheets and blankets, but we advise parents to pack a pillow in the child's bag as we don't provide one.
Sheets（床单）和 blankets（毯子）是学校提供的，不需要家长放进包里。
题目说把什么东西放进包里（put... in bag），对应录音中建议家长 "pack a pillow"。
The best thing is to call the teacher on the classroom mobile... Shall I give you the number? Yes, please. Okay. It's 0914638520.
数字较长时，注意跟随录音的停顿分组记忆（通常是3-3-4或4-3-3的节奏），防止漏听。
这是一个纯数字听写，按照录音节奏直接写下 0914638520 即可。
